RecorderManager.pause()

Pause recording. This interface can be invoked only after the user has granted the microphone permission to the current Mini Program(Minimum version: 23.9.0).

Tips

  1. The pause interface can be invoked only when the voice recorder is recording. The pause interface cannot be invoked when the voice recording is idle or paused.
  2. The pause operation is performed on the recording manager. The operation result is obtained from the recording manager, which is different from the callback mode of common interfaces. The recorder pauses normally and can be detected by using RecorderManager.onPause (listener). An error can be detected by using RecorderManager.onError(listener).

Sample Code

<button bindtap="recorderPause" type="primary">recorderPause</button>

Page({
    recorderPause() {
        recorderManager.pause();
    }
})
